claim: Amazon charges aged inventory costs monthly for all items stored in a fulfillment center for more than 181 days.
evidence: Charged monthly for all items stored in a fulfillment center for more than 181 days.

claim: Amazon says maintaining sound inventory health can help you avoid the aged inventory cost.
evidence: Maintaining sound inventory health can help you avoid this cost.

claim: For the April 15, 2023 assessment date, Amazon increased the surcharges applied to inventory stored between 271 and 365 days.
evidence: We will increase the surcharges applied to inventory stored between 271-365 days.

claim: Amazon added aged inventory surcharges on inventory stored 180-270 days, excluding Apparel, Shoes, Bags, Jewelry and Watches.
evidence: aged inventory surcharges on inventory stored between 180-270 days, excluding products in the following categories: Apparel, Shoes, Bags, Jewelry, and Watches.

claim: Those aged inventory changes took effect for the April 15, 2023 aged inventory assessment date.
evidence: These changes will take effect for the April 15, 2023 aged inventory assessment date.

claim: Amazon said the aged inventory changes would drive more efficient use of storage and create capacity for sellers using space efficiently.
evidence: These changes will help drive more efficient use of our storage and create more capacity for sellers who are using space efficiently.

claim: Amazon will remove the aged inventory surcharge and combine it with monthly storage fees into a single, age-based rate.
evidence: We’ll also remove the aged inventory surcharge and combine it with monthly storage fees into a single, age-based rate.

claim: Amazon's storage changes, including the eliminated storage utilization surcharge, are effective February 1, 2027.
evidence: Effective February 1, 2027, we’ll eliminate the storage utilization surcharge

claim: Amazon says the new structure means flat or lower fees for inventory that turns in under six months and higher fees for aged inventory.
evidence: These changes will result in flat or lower fees for inventory that turns in under six months, higher fees for aged inventory

claim: Amazon can return, dispose of, or liquidate your inventory in a fulfillment center for a per-item charge.
evidence: You can have Amazon return, dispose of, or liquidate your inventory in a fulfillment center for a per-item charge.

claim: The SP-API Long-Term Storage Fee Charges report contains the charge data for long-term storage.
evidence: Contains the charge data for long-term storage.

claim: The Manage Inventory Health report gives a consolidated view across sales over 7, 30, 60 and 90 days and shipment statuses.
evidence: Provides a consolidated view across your sales (7, 30, 60, and 90 days)
verifier_note: Evidence trimmed to the verbatim part confirmed on re-fetch; shipment statuses confirmed in the same description.

claim: Amazon's inventory management guide lists over 90 days of supply and at least one unit aged over 90 days among the situations in which it considers you to have excess inventory.
evidence: Amazon considers you to have excess inventory if you have: Over 90 days of supply At least one unit aged over 90 days
verifier_note: Source list also includes 'a better ROI opportunity'; claim and page reworded as 'among'.

claim: Amazon's inventory guide warns that aging inventory could force you to liquidate.
evidence: aging inventory could force you to liquidate.

claim: Through the FBA New Selection Program, sellers launching new products can liquidate products at no cost within 180 days if they don't perform as expected.
evidence: pay no monthly storage fees, and liquidate products at no cost within 180 days if they don’t perform as expected.

claim: Amazon listed maintaining healthy inventory levels among the ways to reach lower fee options for 2026.
evidence: including by updating your product packaging, selecting lower cost inbound shipment options, and maintaining healthy inventory levels.

claim: Amazon says FBA inventory storage costs are charged monthly based on the daily average volume, measured in cubic feet, of the space inventory occupies in Amazon fulfillment centers.
evidence: storage costs are charged monthly based on the daily average volume (measured in cubic feet) for the space your inventory occupies in Amazon fulfillment centers.
verifier_note: Drafted evidence wording not on sell.amazon.com/fulfillment-by-amazon; replaced with the published sentence (same meaning).
